plans.name: Moderato
plans.billing: Monthly or annual; credits refresh each month
plans.note: Agent credits are approximate values based on typical task token consumption. Monthly credits are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for the same feature and are for reference only. All membership features share one credit pool metered by token usage. Kimi Code has a separate 5-hour / weekly rate limit, but the page does not state its numeric allowance.
